gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Follow these steps to generate your first AI-powered SEO articles

createProject.title: Create a Project
createProject.description: Connect your website to AutopilotRank. Choose from WordPress (native REST API integration), Webhook (for Shopify, Webflow, Ghost, custom platforms), or Manual mode.
createProject.tip: Tip: WordPress users can install our plugin for one-click setup

addKeywords.title: Add Keywords
addKeywords.description: Enter target keywords manually one-by-one, or upload a CSV file for bulk import. Connect Google Search Console to discover keyword opportunities from your existing traffic.
addKeywords.tip: Tip: Long-tail keywords often have less competition and higher conversion rates

generateArticles.title: Generate Articles
generateArticles.description: Choose your AI model preset (Budget, Balanced, Pro, or Ultra) and content settings. Each article costs 1-5 credits depending on the model. Hit Generate to start.
generateArticles.tip: Tip: Budget preset is great for informational content; Ultra for money pages

reviewPublish.title: Review & Publish
reviewPublish.description: Edit generated articles in our Markdown editor. Approve content for publishing, or let our full autopilot mode publish automatically after QA checks pass.
reviewPublish.tip: Tip: Review mode lets you approve each article before it goes live

creditsBilling.title: Credits & Billing
creditsBilling.subtitle: Understand how credits work and choose the right plan

howCreditsWork.question: How do credits work?
howCreditsWork.answer: Credits are used to generate articles. Each article costs 1-5 credits depending on your AI model preset: Budget (1 credit), Balanced (1 credit), Pro (2 credits), or Ultra (3 credits). Image generation add-ons cost 0-2 additional credits depending on the image preset.

subscriptionPlans.question: What subscription plans are available?
subscriptionPlans.answer: We offer three plans: Starter ($49/mo, 30 articles), Growth ($99/mo, 100 articles), and Agency ($249/mo, 500 articles). All plans include multi-model AI (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini), our Humanizer engine, and SEO scoring.

creditPacks.question: Can I buy extra credits?
creditPacks.answer: Yes! Credit packs are available for one-time purchase: 10 articles for $9.99, 25 articles for $19.99 (best value), or 50 articles for $34.99. Credits from packs never expire.

rollover.question: Do unused credits roll over?
rollover.answer: Yes! On Starter and Growth plans, unused subscription credits roll over month-to-month up to 3x your monthly limit. For example, Growth (100/mo) can accumulate up to 300 credits. Agency plan uses a use-it-or-lose-it model.

trialCredits.question: Do you offer a free trial?
trialCredits.answer: Yes! New users get 3 free trial articles to test the platform. No credit card required. Use these credits to generate articles and see the quality for yourself.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe, our secure payment processor. All transactions are encrypted and PCI-compliant.

cancelSubscription.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancelSubscription.answer: Yes! You can cancel anytime through your Billing Dashboard or the Stripe customer portal. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period, and any remaining credits will stay in your account.

refunds.question: What is your refund policy?
refunds.answer: Due to the computationally expensive nature of AI generation, all purchases are final and we do not offer refunds. You can cancel your subscription at any time to prevent future charges.

supportedCms.question: What CMS platforms do you support?
supportedCms.answer: WordPress is fully supported via the REST API with Application Passwords — install our plugin for one-click setup. Webflow integration is coming soon. You can also use our generic webhook to connect Shopify, Ghost, Notion, Wix, or any custom platform.

aiModels.question: What AI models do you use?
aiModels.answer: AutopilotRank offers four model tiers: Budget (Gemini Flash — fast and cost-efficient), Balanced (GPT-4o mini — solid everyday quality), Pro (GPT-4o — high-quality output for competitive pages), and Ultra (Claude Opus — best-in-class for money pages and pillar content). You choose the tier per campaign or per article.

humanizer.question: How does the AI humanizer work?
humanizer.answer: Every generated article passes through our built-in humanizer as a post-processing step before delivery. The humanizer detects and rewrites AI-typical sentence patterns — repetitive structures, robotic transitions, over-formal phrasing — transforming them into natural, human-sounding prose. This helps your content pass AI detectors like GPTZero, Originality.ai, and Copyleaks while remaining factually accurate and SEO-optimized.

gscIntegration.question: How does Google Search Console integration work?
gscIntegration.answer: Connect your Google Search Console to discover keyword opportunities from your existing search traffic. We analyze impressions, clicks, and positions to suggest high-potential keywords you're already ranking for but could improve.

scheduling.question: What scheduling options are available?
scheduling.answer: Choose from 8 frequency options: 3x daily, 2x daily, daily, every other day, 3x weekly, 2x weekly, weekly, or every 2 weeks. Articles are generated and published on your schedule automatically.

approvalWorkflow.question: Can I review content before publishing?
approvalWorkflow.answer: Yes! Choose between three modes: (1) Full autopilot - content publishes automatically after QA passes, (2) Review mode - content queued for your approval in the dashboard, (3) Draft mode - content saved as drafts in your CMS for manual review.

qualityIssues.question: What if I'm not happy with the content quality?
qualityIssues.answer: Our Humanizer engine ensures natural, readable content. If an article doesn't meet your standards, you can regenerate it (uses additional credits) or edit it directly in our Markdown editor. Contact support if you see systematic issues.

failedProcessing.question: What happens if article generation fails?
failedProcessing.answer: If generation fails due to a system error, your credits are automatically refunded. Check the campaign status page for error details. Common issues include API rate limits or temporary AI model unavailability. Most issues resolve automatically on retry.

dataPrivacy.question: Is my data secure and private?
dataPrivacy.answer: Yes! We take privacy seriously: data is processed securely via HTTPS, we don't use your content to train models, and we comply with data protection regulations including GDPR. Read our Privacy Policy for full details.
